description: Java interface defining a data source for the OpenMRS logic service engine. Includes method signatures for extracting data and retrieving metadata about data keys.

classes.name: LogicDataSource
classes.description: Interface for data source implementations that provide data to the logic service engine. Defines methods for data retrieval, key management, and default TTL.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a collection of key strings representing available data elements in the data source.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key is available within the data source.

methods.name: getDefaultTTL
methods.description: Provides the default time-to-live value for cached results in seconds.
